responseLandingTxt1: [W] You must respond within 28 days of the date of the claim form being sent by the tribunal.
responseLandingTxt2: [W] You must respond to the claim even if you believe that another respondent is liable.
responseLandingTxt3,: Os na fyddwch yn darparu ymateb, gellir cyhoeddi dyfarniad yn eich erbyn heb wrandawiad.
responseLandingTxt4: [W] If you consider another person or company may be liable, you should still submit a response. You can explain why you think someone else may be liable in section 3 of the form
